description: This file defines a utility function 'shapeStackedSeries' used to process raw cost data records into a format suitable for visualization with Recharts. It aggregates costs by service and category (or environment), handling sorting and unknown labels.

methods.name: shapeStackedSeries(records, stackBy = "environment", options)
methods.description: Aggregates input cost records into a structured dataset suitable for stacked series visualization, organizing by specified grouping ('environment' or 'cost_category'), with options for sorting and labeling.
